subject: Media Literacy
title: Personalized Ads and Filter Bubbles
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Personalized Ads and Filter Bubbles.

hook.text: Two people search the same product and see completely different ads based on their digital profiles.

buildup.text: Personalized advertising uses your data to show you products that match your existing beliefs and interests.

discovery.text: This creates ad filter bubbles — you only see products and messages that reinforce your current identity.

twist.text: Personalization feels like convenience. But it narrows your world to a reflection of your past behavior.

climax.text: When every ad confirms who you already are, you lose the chance to discover who else you could be.

punchline.text: The algorithm knows who you were. Not who you could become.

quiz.question: What problem do personalized ad filter bubbles create?
options: They narrow your world to reflect only your past behavior
